name: Spire Totem
body:
Spire Totem (Su)
Source Wilderness Origins pg. 24
While raging, the barbarian takes no penalties for using a weapon to deal nonlethal damage. When dealing nonlethal damage, the barbarian adds a bonus equal to half her barbarian level on her damage rolls. A barbarian must have the lesser spire totem rage power and be at least 6th level to select this rage power.
